title: 붙여넣기 주문 영업방 원문의 현장 추가취소방 전달 근거

criteria.request: Authenticated POST with selected year and full year-week-subweek, at most 200 raw sources, at most 20000 characters per source and 200000 total characters. accountActive=false is forbidden. No sending or ERP write.
criteria.source: Only canonical nenovakakao|chat_id|external_message_id identities from 영업방 with exact original raw text and valid nonapproximate timezone-bearing timestamp in selected KST year can match. Uploaded rows remain UNCONFIRMED.
criteria.target: Fixed authenticated nenova-delivery-feed endpoint only, room exactly 현장 추가취소방, source nenovakakao, distinct valid identity, target timestamp not before source and in selected KST year. No legacy fallback.
criteria.match: Complete text equality after NFC and whitespace normalization only. Duplicate source texts/identities or multiple qualifying targets are AMBIGUOUS. Partial, truncated, approximate, cross-year and earlier targets cannot produce DELIVERED.
criteria.capacity: KST current inclusive recent seven calendar days, <=200 target rows per page and <=20 pages; incomplete or invalid feed fails closed with 502. Whole upstream scan has a 15 second deadline. Successful fixed-period feed cached for 30 seconds; failures never cached.
criteria.response: Returns source identity/status and only matched deliveryIdentity/deliveredAt. No unrelated target raw messages, token, sending capability or ERP application claim. DELIVERED means exact forwarding evidence only.
criteria.metadataRefresh: For identical raw text and canonical identical identity only, refresh source identity metadata. Upgrade approximate timestamp only from explicitly nonapproximate valid fresh timestamp. Preserve all UI/analysis fields. Carry truncated/is_truncated through requests.
criteria.diagnostics: Return reason codes for unconfirmed/ambiguous results and safe aggregate targetCount / qualifiedSourceCount; no target raw text is returned. UI distinguishes missing source metadata, approximate/invalid year-time, incomplete source and absent exact target.
criteria.loading: Initial/scope-change rows show waiting then checking, never unconfirmed before lookup. Same actor/year/week exact row fingerprints retain prior evidence while new rows refresh. Any failed refresh clears all green evidence and explicitly shows lookup failure.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025 source and 2027 target cannot confirm selected 2026 year; selected full week must share year.

dnspyEvidence.note: Web-only Kakao read; native evidence documents the preserved ERP boundary. No native SQL or save behavior is invoked or modified.
